public_definer_functions.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_browse_community_shots(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare entries jsonb; total_count integer; member_id uuid;
begin
 member_id:=private.require_member();
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 40 or
    p_offset is null or p_offset not between 0 and 2000 then
   raise exception using errcode='22023',
    message='Community page size or offset is invalid.';
 end if;
 select count(*)::integer into total_count
 from public.community_shots cs
 join public.coffees coffee on coffee.id=cs.coffee_id
 where cs.quality_state='eligible' and coffee.verification_state='verified';

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'coffee_name',page.coffee_name,'roaster',page.roaster,
   'release_key',page.release_key,'release_label',page.release_label,
   'release_origin',page.release_origin,'release_process',page.release_process,
   'release_producer',page.release_producer,'release_variety',page.release_variety,
   'release_roast_level',page.release_roast_level,
   'style',page.style,'observed_on',page.observed_on,
   'dose_g',page.dose_g,'yield_g',page.yield_g,
   'ratio',page.ratio,'time_s',page.time_s,
   'extraction',page.extraction,'body',page.body,
   'clarity',page.clarity,'sweetness',page.sweetness,
   'astringency',page.astringency,
   'shot_count',page.shot_count,
   'contributor_count',page.contributor_count
 ) order by page.observed_on desc,page.sort_id desc),'[]'::jsonb)
 into entries from (
  select cs.id as sort_id,cs.observed_on,cs.style,cs.dose_g,
    cs.yield_g,cs.ratio,cs.time_s,cs.extraction,cs.body,
    cs.clarity,cs.sweetness,cs.astringency,
    coffee.name as coffee_name,coffee.roaster,
    encode(sha256(convert_to(coffee.id::text,'UTF8')),'hex') as release_key,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.release_label),'') as release_label,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.origin),'') as release_origin,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.process),'') as release_process,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.producer),'') as release_producer,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.variety),'') as release_variety,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.roast_level),'') as release_roast_level,
    (select count(*)::integer from public.community_shots sibling
      join public.coffees canon on canon.id=sibling.coffee_id
      where sibling.coffee_id=cs.coffee_id and sibling.style=cs.style
        and sibling.quality_state='eligible'
        and canon.verification_state='verified') as shot_count,
    (select count(distinct link.contributor_id)::integer
      from public.community_shots sibling
      join private.contribution_links link on link.community_shot_id=sibling.id
      where sibling.coffee_id=cs.coffee_id and sibling.style=cs.style
        and sibling.quality_state='eligible') as contributor_count
  from public.community_shots cs
  join public.coffees coffee on coffee.id=cs.coffee_id
  where cs.quality_state='eligible' and coffee.verification_state='verified'
  order by cs.observed_on desc,cs.id desc
  limit p_limit offset p_offset
 ) page;
 return jsonb_build_object('shots',entries,'total',total_count,
    'offset',p_offset,'page_size',p_limit);
end $function$
public_definer_functions.semantic_review: Admitted member guard; bounded pagination; eligible verified public Community projections only.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_community_evidence_counts(p_coffee_id uuid, p_style text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n bigint; people bigint;
begin
 perform private.require_member();
 select count(*),count(distinct l.contributor_id) into n,people
 from public.community_shots c
 join private.contribution_links l on l.community_shot_id=c.id
 join public.coffees verified on verified.id=c.coffee_id
 where c.coffee_id=p_coffee_id and c.style=p_style and c.quality_state='eligible'
  and verified.verification_state='verified';
 return jsonb_build_object('shot_count',n,'contributor_count',people);
end $function$
public_definer_functions.semantic_review: Member required; counts only verified eligible contributed shots.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_community_recommendation_evidence(p_library_entry_id uuid, p_style text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare me uuid; target public.coffees; result jsonb;
begin
 me:=private.require_member();
 if p_style is null or p_style not in ('Traditional','Turbo','Ristretto','Lungo','Custom','Fast-Flow')
    then raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Unknown espresso style';end if;
 select c.* into target from public.library_entries le
 join public.coffees c on c.id=le.coffee_id
 where le.id=p_library_entry_id and le.owner_id=me and le.hidden_at is null
   and c.verification_state='verified' and c.merged_into_id is null;
 if not found then
  return jsonb_build_object('style',p_style,'candidates','[]'::jsonb);
 end if;
 with matching as (
  select cs.coffee_id,cl.contributor_id,cs.ratio,cs.time_s,
   -- Only a server-maintained, eligible repeated-success *personal* family
   -- qualifies. Do not infer a family from shot values or trust client labels.
   case when pf.evidence_state='personally_confirmed'
       and s.is_dialed_in and s.personal_family_id=pf.id
       and s.style=cs.style and s.library_entry_id=pf.library_entry_id
       then pf.id else null end as confirmed_personal_family_id,
   floor(cs.ratio/0.25)::integer as observed_bucket,
   case when cs.coffee_id=target.id then 3
        when lower(btrim(c.roaster))=lower(btrim(target.roaster))
          and lower(btrim(c.name))=lower(btrim(target.name))
          and nullif(btrim(c.release_label),'') is not null
          and nullif(btrim(target.release_label),'') is not null
          and c.release_label<>target.release_label then 4
        when nullif(btrim(c.roast_level),'')=nullif(btrim(target.roast_level),'')
          and (
            (nullif(btrim(c.origin),'') is not null and lower(btrim(c.origin))=lower(btrim(target.origin)))
            or
            (nullif(btrim(c.process),'') is not null and lower(btrim(c.process))=lower(btrim(target.process)))
          ) then 6
        else 99 end as tier
  from public.community_shots cs
  join public.coffees c on c.id=cs.coffee_id
  join private.contribution_links cl on cl.community_shot_id=cs.id
  join private.contributors contributor on contributor.id=cl.contributor_id
  left join public.shots s on s.id=cl.shot_id and s.owner_id=contributor.owner_id
      and s.style=cs.style and s.personal_family_id is not null
  left join public.personal_recipe_families pf on pf.id=s.personal_family_id
      and pf.owner_id=s.owner_id and pf.library_entry_id=s.library_entry_id
      and pf.style=s.style
  where cs.style=p_style and cs.quality_state='eligible' and c.verification_state='verified'
    and c.merged_into_id is null and cs.ratio between 0.5 and 8 and cs.time_s between 1 and 180
    -- A user's own Community projection must never reinforce their personal
    -- evidence as if it came from another independent contributor.
    and contributor.owner_id is distinct from me
 ), member_groups as (
  select tier,coffee_id,contributor_id,ratio,time_s,
    confirmed_personal_family_id is not null as confirmed,
    case when confirmed_personal_family_id is not null
      then 'family:'||confirmed_personal_family_id::text
      else 'observation:'||observed_bucket::text end as member_group
  from matching where tier in (3,4,6)
 ), member_centers as (
  -- Preserve a real person's repeatedly successful family even if its shots
  -- straddle two arbitrary 0.25 bucket edges.
  select tier,coffee_id,contributor_id,member_group,
    bool_or(confirmed) as personally_confirmed,
    count(*)::integer as shot_count,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by ratio)::numeric as ratio_center,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by time_s)::numeric as time_center
  from member_groups
  group by tier,coffee_id,contributor_id,member_group
 ), member_buckets as (
  -- One observation per independent person per estimated Community ratio
  -- region; multiple shots or personal families from one member cannot
  -- multiply that person's influence.
  select tier,coffee_id,contributor_id,
    floor(ratio_center/0.25)::integer as ratio_group,
    sum(shot_count)::integer as shot_count,
    count(*) filter(where personally_confirmed)::integer as confirmed_family_count,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by ratio_center)::numeric as ratio_center,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by time_center)::numeric as time_center
  from member_centers
  group by tier,coffee_id,contributor_id,floor(ratio_center/0.25)::integer
 ), ranked as (
  select tier,coffee_id,ratio_group,
    count(*)::integer as contributor_count,
    sum(shot_count)::integer as shot_count,
    sum(confirmed_family_count)::integer as confirmed_personal_family_count,
    count(*) filter(where confirmed_family_count>0)::integer as confirmed_family_contributors,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by ratio_center)::numeric as ratio_center,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by time_center)::numeric as time_center
  from member_buckets
  group by tier,coffee_id,ratio_group
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'tier',case tier when 3 then 'exact' when 4 then 'related_release' else 'similar_coffee' end,
   'style',p_style,'ratio',round(ratio_center,3),'time_s',round(time_center,2),
   'shot_count',shot_count,'contributor_count',contributor_count,
   'confirmed_personal_family_count',confirmed_personal_family_count,
   'confirmed_family_contributors',confirmed_family_contributors,
   'distinct_family_basis',case when confirmed_personal_family_count>0
      then 'confirmed_personal_families_in_observed_ratio_group'
      else 'ratio_bucket_observed' end,
   'community_group_identity_verified',false,
   'source','eligible_verified_community','calibrated_grind',false
 ) order by tier,contributor_count desc,shot_count desc,ratio_center,coffee_id)
 , '[]'::jsonb) into result
 from (select * from ranked order by tier,contributor_count desc,shot_count desc,ratio_center,coffee_id
 limit 30) x;
 return jsonb_build_object('style',p_style,'candidates',result);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_my_community_outliers()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare member_id uuid; entries jsonb;
begin
 member_id:=private.require_member();
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'shot_id',recent.id,'revision',recent.revision,
    'coffee_name',recent.coffee_name,'roaster',recent.roaster,
    'style',recent.style,'dose_g',recent.dose_g,
    'yield_g',recent.yield_g,'time_s',recent.time_s
 ) order by recent.pulled_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into entries
 from (
    select s.id,s.revision,s.pulled_at,s.style,s.dose_g,s.yield_g,
      s.time_s,coffee.name as coffee_name,coffee.roaster
    from public.shots s
    join private.contribution_links link on link.shot_id=s.id
      and link.source_revision=s.revision
    join public.community_shots cs on cs.id=link.community_shot_id
      and cs.quality_state='held'
    join private.community_quality_checks qc on qc.community_shot_id=cs.id
      and qc.reason='extreme_outlier'
    join public.coffees coffee on coffee.id=cs.coffee_id
      and coffee.verification_state='verified'
    where s.owner_id=member_id and s.hidden_at is null
      and s.is_dialed_in
    order by s.pulled_at desc,s.id desc
    limit 10
 ) recent;
 return entries;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_search_community_shots(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_style text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare entries jsonb; total_count integer; member_id uuid; q text;
begin
 member_id:=private.require_member();
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 40 or
    p_offset is null or p_offset not between 0 and 2000 then
   raise exception using errcode='22023',
    message='Community page size or offset is invalid.';
 end if;
 if p_query is null or length(p_query)>80 or p_style is null or length(p_style)>40 then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Community search parameters are invalid.';
 end if;
 q:=lower(btrim(p_query));
 select count(*)::integer into total_count
 from public.community_shots cs
 join public.coffees coffee on coffee.id=cs.coffee_id
 where cs.quality_state='eligible' and coffee.verification_state='verified'
  and (p_style='all' or cs.style=p_style)
  and (q='' or strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',coffee.name,coffee.roaster,coffee.release_label,coffee.origin,coffee.process,coffee.producer,coffee.variety,coffee.roast_level)),q)>0);

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'coffee_name',page.coffee_name,'roaster',page.roaster,
   'release_key',page.release_key,'release_label',page.release_label,
   'release_origin',page.release_origin,'release_process',page.release_process,
   'release_producer',page.release_producer,'release_variety',page.release_variety,
   'release_roast_level',page.release_roast_level,
   'style',page.style,'observed_on',page.observed_on,
   'dose_g',page.dose_g,'yield_g',page.yield_g,
   'ratio',page.ratio,'time_s',page.time_s,
   'extraction',page.extraction,'body',page.body,
   'clarity',page.clarity,'sweetness',page.sweetness,
   'astringency',page.astringency,
   'shot_count',page.shot_count,
   'contributor_count',page.contributor_count
 ) order by page.observed_on desc,page.sort_id desc),'[]'::jsonb)
 into entries from (
  select cs.id as sort_id,cs.observed_on,cs.style,cs.dose_g,
    cs.yield_g,cs.ratio,cs.time_s,cs.extraction,cs.body,
    cs.clarity,cs.sweetness,cs.astringency,
    coffee.name as coffee_name,coffee.roaster,
    encode(sha256(convert_to(coffee.id::text,'UTF8')),'hex') as release_key,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.release_label),'') as release_label,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.origin),'') as release_origin,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.process),'') as release_process,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.producer),'') as release_producer,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.variety),'') as release_variety,
    nullif(btrim(coffee.roast_level),'') as release_roast_level,
    (select count(*)::integer from public.community_shots sibling
      join public.coffees canon on canon.id=sibling.coffee_id
      where sibling.coffee_id=cs.coffee_id and sibling.style=cs.style
        and sibling.quality_state='eligible'
        and canon.verification_state='verified') as shot_count,
    (select count(distinct link.contributor_id)::integer
      from public.community_shots sibling
      join private.contribution_links link on link.community_shot_id=sibling.id
      where sibling.coffee_id=cs.coffee_id and sibling.style=cs.style
        and sibling.quality_state='eligible') as contributor_count
  from public.community_shots cs
  join public.coffees coffee on coffee.id=cs.coffee_id
  where cs.quality_state='eligible' and coffee.verification_state='verified'
  and (p_style='all' or cs.style=p_style)
  and (q='' or strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',coffee.name,coffee.roaster,coffee.release_label,coffee.origin,coffee.process,coffee.producer,coffee.variety,coffee.roast_level)),q)>0)
  order by cs.observed_on desc,cs.id desc
  limit p_limit offset p_offset
 ) page;
 return jsonb_build_object('shots',entries,'total',total_count,
    'offset',p_offset,'page_size',p_limit);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_member()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from private.beta_members m where m.owner_id=(select auth.uid()) and m.enabled);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_member()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid:=auth.uid();
begin
 if u is null or not private.is_member() then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='An admitted beta account is required.'; end if;
 return u;
end $function$
